facts.statement: Adamantisaurus lived during the Late Cretaceous Period, specifically between the Turonian and early Maastrichtian stages, approximately 93 to 70 million years ago.
facts.quote: The Adamantina probably occurs somewhere between the Turonian through early Maastrichtian stages of the Late Cretaceous Period (93 to 70 million years ago).

facts.statement: Adamantisaurus lived at the end of the Cretaceous Period, approximately 75 million years ago during the Campanian stage, in what is now South America.
facts.quote: que vivió a finales del período Cretácico, hace aproximadamente 75 millones de años, en el Campaniense, en lo que hoy es Sudamérica.

facts.statement: Researchers believe Adamantisaurus may have been armored, though its general appearance remains a mystery until more fossils are found.
facts.quote: Se cree que puede haber sido acorazado, aunque su aspecto general seguirá siendo un misterio hasta que se hallen más fósiles.

facts.statement: Adamantisaurus is classified within the family Saltasauridae.
Adamantisaurus belongs to the tribe Aeolosaurini.
All titanosaurs at least as derived as Malawisaurus, including Adamantisaurus, are members of the clade Lithostrotia.

facts.statement: Because Adamantisaurus is incompletely known, its exact phylogenetic relationships are difficult to establish.
